label: main street end to end, east -> west: from the S5 seam past 孙羊正店, the storyteller and the crossroads to the well's end
why: along the street (D 7.0, then D 8.5 past the painted monk and scholars standing on the centre line at X -70..-72.5), 40 m; the last 4 m to the well are the paper stall's painted crowd. Nothing unpainted may block it (the walker slides along the painted figures' bodies, so it ends 1-2 m short of a free walk)

label: main street end to end, west -> east: from the well back to the S5 seam
up the cross street (east side, past the 太平车) to the top street, then west along it
why: the 太平车 and its team fill the cross street's middle (painted), so the walk keeps to the clear lane by the corner shop's west wall (X -69.8), then the top street's clear lane (D 26.2)

label: into 孙羊正店's open front (between the doorman and the 香 lamp-box) to the back of the front room
why: the front room ends at its dark back wall (a colliding board at D 16.48): the room behind it is not painted

label: into the 孫羊店 butcher's open front (between its middle posts) to its back wall
into the cloth shop's open front (top street, east of its counters) to its back
into the incense shop's open front from the cross street (between its scaffold poles, north of the big wagon's lead mules)
why: the wagon's team (real size) stands across the shop's south half and the scaffold poles stand at 0.45-1.25 m: the way in is the 0.7 m gap between the pole at D 17.9 and the 劉家 signboard; the open front ends at its dark back (a colliding board): the hall behind it is not painted

label: round the well: along its south side to the west edge
why: heading west into the slanted west edge, the walker stops and slides north-west along it (the edge runs NW), so the end is a range along the edge
